verdicts.reason: A crams the image strip and the '& Baby Toddler BEDDING' title into the top 140px. That leaves roughly 75% of the canvas as dead navy, with the dot grids floating at mid-height for no reason, so it reads as a broken, top-heavy layout. B keeps the same thin, shrunken image strip at the top but centres the title vertically and moves the dots to the corners, which gives better balance. It is still mostly empty, though: the ampersand sits almost on the left edge, the small 'Baby Toddler' text is cramped against it, and nothing was actually redesigned for the tall format.
